page.content:
Chris and Regan — actress mother and possessed daughter.

How MacNeil family connects

  • Character: Regan MacNeil — Regan is the MacNeil daughter at the story's center.
  • Creator: Chris MacNeil — Chris is the mother holding the MacNeil household together.
  • Location: Georgetown — The MacNeils are living in Georgetown during the film.
  • Character: Sharon Spencer — Sharon helps Chris run the Georgetown house.

What is MacNeil family?

The MacNeil family is the household the possession invades: Chris filming in Georgetown, Regan left with a Ouija board and a voice calling itself Captain Howdy.

Key threads lead to Regan MacNeil, Chris MacNeil, Georgetown and Sharon Spencer.
